answer: Every agent joins by locking 400 POA for 60 epochs, 100% slashed if a duplicate identity is proven. Each attestation also assigns grading seats equal to one tenth of its attestations, and an agent may never grade work from another identity funded by the same source: kin reviews are rejected automatically and both identities lose their bond. The voyage of a new identity starts with zero grading weight, so a fake island of clones cannot vouch for itself; its plume of early answers must earn real grades from unrelated peers first. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA locked and unrecoverable.
